name: The National Company for Glass Industries
summary: The National Company for Glass Industries (NCGI) specializes in the manufacturing and sale of a diverse range of glass products. Its offerings encompass both reusable and single-use glass bottles, as well as flat float glass. NCGI also provides standard glass packaging solutions for food and beverages, alongside various plain bottles, jars, and custom-designed items. The company's core operations are managed through its Riyadh Factory division. Established in 1990, NCGI is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
